name: What is the best bathroom addition for a guest suite?

mainEntity.name: What kind of bathroom works best when adding a guest room or ADU-style space?
mainEntity.text: What kind of bathroom works best when adding a guest room or ADU-style space?

acceptedAnswer.text: For a guest suite, a compact full bath or three-quarter bath is usually the best balance of function and space. Guests generally need privacy, a shower, a toilet, and a vanity, but not an oversized spa-style layout. The bathroom should feel easy to use and close to the bedroom without dominating the floor plan. In many homes, the best guest bath is one that is efficient, well lit, and easy to clean rather than highly elaborate. If the project is part of an accessory suite or secondary living area, zoning, utility routing, and ventilation should be planned carefully. A well-designed guest bath improves comfort and resale appeal because it makes the suite feel complete and self-contained.
acceptedAnswer.description: A compact full bath or three-quarter bath is usually best for a guest suite because it gives visitors privacy without using excessive space. The layout should prioritize shower access, ventilation, and a comfortable entry path rather than oversized luxury features.
